Baroque.label: Baroque
Baroque.description: Baroque painting often creates a sense of drama through strong contrasts of light and shadow, expressive gestures, and energetic compositions.

Cubism.label: Cubism
Cubism.description: Cubism breaks subjects into geometric forms and can bring several viewpoints into the same image. Shapes and their relationships become part of the subject.

Impressionism.label: Impressionism
Impressionism.description: Impressionist painting often explores changing light and atmosphere through visible brushwork and relationships between colours, rather than sharply defined detail.

Pop_Art.label: Pop art
Pop_Art.description: Pop art draws on imagery from popular culture, including advertising, comics, and everyday products. Bold colour, repetition, and familiar symbols often play a central role.

Ukiyo_e.label: Ukiyo-e
Ukiyo_e.description: Ukiyo-e is a Japanese tradition of prints and paintings depicting subjects such as landscapes, performers, and daily life. Many works use clear contours and areas of flat colour.
